children: DarkPulse entered into an Exclusive Patent License Agreement with the Department of the Air Force to commercialize satellite power-sharing, satellite communications, and laser-generation technologies. The deal includes a $15,000 upfront fee, a 5% running royalty on non-government sales, and minimum annual royalties rising to $400,000 from year four onward. DarkPulse must develop and launch a product within 30 months and manufacture royalty-based products substantially in the U.S., while the government retains royalty-free rights for its own use. The license runs until the last patent expires or earlier termination and requires DarkPulse to cover patent maintenance fees.
